changes.description: Add blog section with index and dynamic post pages
Add JSON-LD structured data for better SEO
Integrate Google Analytics
Enhance PWA manifest with categories, shortcuts, screenshots, and improved icon support
Update sitemap to include blog pages
Add Tailwind CSS Typography plugin for improved article styling
Harden security and performance defaults via Next.js headers and config optimizations
Add zoom controls, statistics panel, and loading skeleton to QR preview
Implement drag-and-drop, paste support, and image info display in image scanner
Improve camera scanner torch detection and remove unused UI elements
Enhance accessibility with button titles and better error handling
Update footer developer credits to include Yoguru team
Initial release of YOQR - Complete QR code generator and scanner platform
Advanced QR code customization with colors, patterns, logos, and effects
Real-time QR code preview with instant download and copy functionality
Camera-based QR code scanning with continuous scan mode
Support for multiple QR code types (URL, Text, WiFi, Contact, Email, SMS, Geo, Phone)
Privacy-focused design with no data collection
Responsive design optimized for mobile and desktop
PWA support for offline functionality
Modern UI with dark/light theme support
SEO optimized with proper meta tags and sitemap
